brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Multicompartment bin for small sewing notions (pins, needles, buttons)
Divided storage for medium supplies (thread spools, scissors)
Open bin for larger fabric pieces / general storage

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell hex cluster with varied bins: 3-compartment for tiny notions, 2-compartment for spools/tools, and full open bin for fabric. Provides tidy segmented storage for sewing supplies.
